description: One document per chronic condition the generator can produce, each carrying a concern statement, a goal template with a measurable target, and intervention options with named owners. These are OUR words describing well-established clinical concepts; no guideline, criteria set or reference work is reproduced here. Illustrative only, over synthetic patients, and no substitute for clinical judgement.
